subjects.description: Broken, unrecognizable animals with extra limbs, melted faces, and anatomy that changes from frame to frame.
subjects.appearance_details: Smeared fur, missing eyes, duplicate tails, and textures that crawl independently of the body.
subjects.relationship: Subjects fail to occupy a stable place in the scene and drift through snow or trunks.
subjects.location: Random placement, often cropped by the frame
subjects.action: Teleports, slides without footsteps, or freezes while the background continues
subjects.state_changes: Species, color, and limb count change mid-shot

background_setting: A collapsed forest with repeating tiled snow, swimming bark textures, and trees that pop in and out. No coherent ground plane.

lighting.conditions: Flat, flickering illumination with sudden day-to-night cuts
lighting.direction: Shadow directions that disagree with any single sun
lighting.shadows: Missing contact shadows, crawling shadow maps, and strobing under the subject
lighting.illumination_effect: Harsh digital look with no atmospheric depth

aesthetics.composition: No subject, horizon tilt, and important action cut off by the frame
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neon oversaturation, banding, and color that does not match a winter dawn
aesthetics.patterns: Visible tiling, moire, and aliasing on snow and needles

cinematography.camera_motion: Jerky handheld shake, sudden cuts, and camera clipping through trunks
cinematography.framing: Unbalanced, with the subject lost in empty snow or jammed against a corner
cinematography.camera_angle: Disorienting Dutch angles and accidental ceiling shots
cinematography.depth_of_field: Everything equally soft or equally sharp with no focus plane
cinematography.focus: Hunting autofocus, chromatic fringing, and smear on motion
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Extreme wide-angle distortion or random zoom

style_medium: Heavily compressed video with block artifacts
context: A failed generation that should be avoided

actions.description: Subjects morph, stutter, and lose temporal continuity while the background wobbles

segments.description: One unbroken shot of unstable geometry and flicker

temporal_caption: The clip is temporally broken from the first frame: shapes smear, frames drop, and the scene never settles into a readable walk through a forest.
physical_realism: Snow does not compress under paws, bodies pass through trees, and motion ignores weight and friction.
